title: Fart
blurb: The fart sound. Comedy's oldest special effect, undefeated since the invention of air. This is the clean, classic version — the one that works on toddlers, CEOs, and everyone in between, because absolutely nobody is above it. Use it for chair pranks, video punchlines, or the precise moment someone sits down in a quiet meeting. Timeless, shameless, essential.
origin: The eternal classic. No origin needed; farts predate the internet.
